Pfizer's average quarterly net income over fiscal 2025 was about **$1.94 billion**.

Pfizer's FY2025 10-K shows net income before noncontrolling interests of $7,812 million. Subtracting $41 million attributable to noncontrolling interests gives net income attributable to Pfizer of $7,771 million, which matches the figure on Wikipedia's Pfizer page.

The average is $7,771 million ÷ 4 = about $1,942.75 million per quarter.

I read "net income" as the amount attributable to Pfizer. On the pre-noncontrolling-interest figure, the average would be $1,953 million.
